mapper.sql: id, user_id, target_type, target_id, target_title, browse_date, browse_time, duration_seconds, source, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO browse_history (user_id, target_type, target_id, target_title, browse_date, browse_time, duration_seconds, source, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetTitle}, CURDATE(), NOW(), #{durationSeconds}, #{source}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND browse_date = #{date} ORDER BY browse_time DESC
SELECT FROM browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND browse_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY browse_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND browse_date = #{date}
SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(browse_date, '%Y-%m-%d') FROM browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND browse_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY browse_date DESC
